meaning.en: An English patronymic surname​ derived from the given name Matthew.
meaning.vi: Một họ viết tắt tiếng Anh bắt nguồn từ tên Matthew.

sentences.en: To James Matthews Duncan (1826-1890) we chiefly owe a saner and broader comprehension of the relative importance of the local and the general conditions which enter into the causation of uterine and ovarian disorders.
